excluded.name: Zhihu
excluded.reason: Its terms forbid use of its content by language models.

excluded.name: Xiaohongshu (RedNote)
excluded.reason: Needs a login; its robots.txt disallows everything; scraping it has been prosecuted.

excluded.name: Telegram channels
excluded.reason: Its terms ban deploying AI on its content.

excluded.name: Naver news ranking
excluded.reason: Its robots.txt prohibits use for retrieval-augmented generation.

excluded.name: Naver Search API
excluded.reason: Its terms ban feeding results to AI.

excluded.name: TikTok
excluded.reason: Its Research API is for academic and non-profit researchers only, and it has no other usable trend API.

excluded.name: LinkedIn
excluded.reason: Its User Agreement bans scraping and bots, and it has no post-search API.

excluded.name: Hacker News (Firebase API)
excluded.reason: Not excluded by its terms: left out because Algolia's search reads the same stories with counts and history.

excluded.name: Kaskus hot threads
excluded.reason: Not excluded by its terms: its page draws its thread list in the browser, so there is no list in it for the worker to read.

excluded.name: ShareChat trending
excluded.reason: Not excluded by its terms: its trending page carries no list in its HTML or JSON-LD, so there is nothing for the worker to read without a browser.

excluded.name: X (counts and recent search)
excluded.reason: Pay-per-use: Tavi uses no paid service.

excluded.name: Yandex Wordstat
excluded.reason: Billed per request through Yandex Cloud: Tavi uses no paid service.

excluded.name: Tavily news search
excluded.reason: Billed past its free credits: Tavi uses no paid service.
